prototype_strategy: One modular shared physical prototype; specialized capabilities phased
accounting_policy: Subsystem allocations are envelopes, not spending. Charge each physical component once; cross-reference requirement IDs. Quoted costs require vendor/date; purchases require invoice evidence.
notes: Previous MOB-001..010 estimates are provisional and must be reconciled against these allocations; never added again.
Full-size autonomy, 230V tether and safety certification not funded/validated by this initial prototype envelope.

MOB-011: optional future load cell + HX711 and mounting/calibration estimated ₹500–₹1,100; unquoted, unpurchased, must be accommodated within existing controller/sensors and fabrication envelopes. Current software incremental purchase cost ₹0.

MOB-011 design input: a loaded 5 L cooker may weigh ~6–7 kg; evaluate provisional 10 kg supported-platform transport target, not a 7 kg educational-arm lifting target. Hot cooker handling and unvalidated liquid transport remain blocked. Motor/structure reinforcement cost TBD; keep ₹50,000 ceiling unchanged.
PWR-001: mains tether not funded or physically authorized within first prototype; software precheck never energizes mains. Any mains build needs a separately qualified engineering safety case.

requirement_estimates.notes: Reuse existing controller, IMU and planned tray/arm. Do not double count; no procurement approved. Cooker scenario adds no quoted or purchased item; structural or drive upgrade pricing TBD.
Optional floor-facing sensor, mount and test thresholds; reuse existing IMU, controller and motors. Threshold crossing height and drive torque not physically validated; do not double count.

Reuse IMU, motor controller and encoders if adequate. Optional wheel tread upgrade ₹300–900 and optical sensing ₹300–800; no supplier quotes or purchases. Existing wheel cost must be offset if replaced.
Reuse wheel encoders and IMU; printed absolute-position tags may cost ₹50–200 and optional camera ₹500–1200 if none available. No purchases/quotes; cost not added to ₹50,000 envelope.
Reuse sensors and camera. Optional bumper switches ₹150–450, supplemental ranging ₹300–900, pending actual validation. MOB-020 emergency stop separate and mandatory; avoid double charge.
A* uses existing compute, camera/sensors. Optional printed room markers and measuring consumables ₹0–300, unquoted and unpurchased. Extra mapping sensors TBD if tests justify.
Run virtual Kitchen, Clean and Laundry agents using existing software; no new robots. Optional visible corridor status LED ₹0–250, not safety-rated. No quote or purchase.
Reuse controller, camera, localization and obstacle sensing. Optional floor tags ₹0–150 and docking switch ₹0–350; no purchases or vendor quotes. Dock charger not included.
Reuses basic arm and controller allocations. Optional joint travel switches/brackets ₹150–450 and retention clips/pins ₹150–400; unquoted, unpurchased. Do not double count existing servos.
Optional stow switches and brackets 150–450 INR, retention hardware 150–400 INR. Existing arm and controller reused; no actual purchases.

NC latching mushroom switch + appropriately engineered motor isolate/brake + wiring/protection; price allowance partly supplier-listed, not validated safety design. Procure only after electrical safety review. Fund within existing ₹5,000 power/safety allocation; cost overruns block powered trials.

No DIY 230V tether included in INR 50,000 initial physical prototype. Use already-allocated protected low-voltage supply. Qualified mains isolation, thermal/leakage/fault protection and cable architecture have TBD cost and must not be assumed paid for.

Low-voltage route simulation uses existing supply; optional measuring/marking ₹0–200. Kitchen ≤20m study and Clean/Laundry ≤50m are NOT physical safety ratings. Mains tether and reel cost TBD, outside approved prototype BOM.
Optional unpowered string/spool test hardware ₹0–500 only. Actual low-voltage motorized reel and qualified mains payout cost TBD, not included in ₹50,000. Reuse controller and localization.
Reuse PWR-003 passive cable reel, no repeated motor/encoder count. Optional guides/markings ₹0–250; electrical and mechanical powered reel costs TBD and physical deployment blocked.

Reuses localization camera and simulated cable reel. Optional dry unpowered cable markers/tape ₹0–150, ideally reusing PWR-002 measuring materials. Real cable tracking hardware TBD; no mains cabling purchase.
